name: ui-press-bounce
title: Bounce Press
description: Con trỏ bấm, nút lún xuống 0.92 trong 0.1 s, giữ trong lúc nhấn, thả ra thì nảy lên 1.05 một lần rồi về đúng cỡ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-bounce-press, written here): At the click: scale 1 → 0.92 in 100 ms (power2.out); stays down while held (0.55 s in the demo, press 0.7 s, release 1.25 s); release: 0.92 → 1.05 in 160 ms (power1.out), then 1.05 → 1 in 300 ms (power2.inOut). One rebound only. Pill button 140x46. The cursor arrives on a slight arc (10 % sideways bow) before the press. Params: at: lúc bấm · hold (0.55 s) · down (0.92, 0.1 s) · up (1.05, 0.16 s) · settle (0.3 s).
